summary: Allbirds Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into an amended and restated securities purchase agreement for up to $50M in senior secured convertible notes with an institutional investor. The proceeds will fund a newly formed wholly owned subsidiary, NewBird AI, LLC, to purchase NVIDIA Blackwell GPU server equipment. The filing includes a preliminary proxy statement for a special meeting seeking stockholder approval under Nasdaq Rule 5635(d) for conversion shares exceeding 19.99%. Additionally, the subsidiary entered a $2.75M three-year GPU lease with a QumulusAI subsidiary. This is a structured financing and asset acquisition, not a merger or divestiture, with the notes convertible into Class A common stock. Key watchpoints include stockholder approval at the special meeting and release of escrowed funds upon delivery of final invoices within 14 days.
